map.为数字生成虚拟格子位置编码，结合图像记忆法快速记忆长串数字或词表: Generates virtual grid position codes for numbers, and combines imagery mnemonics to memorize long number strings or word lists quickly

map.记忆宫殿（Method of Loci）把待记项编码为生动意象，依次“放置”在熟: The memory palace (Method of Loci) encodes items to remember as vivid images and places them in order along a familiar spatial path (rooms, a route), retrieving them by walking the path again. Numbers commonly use a
map.（每数对应一个形象）转成可挂钩的意象。: (one image per number) to turn them into images that can be hooked.
map.编码越夸张、多感官，提取越牢；路径越熟悉越稳定。: The more exaggerated and multi-sensory the image, the more firmly it is retrieved; the more familiar the path, the more stable it is.
map.本工具生成编码表与练习序列，纯本地、不上传。: This tool generates a code table and practice sequences, purely local, with nothing uploaded.
map.📚 深度解析：记忆宫殿法（地点桩记忆）: 📚 In-depth: the memory palace method (Method of Loci)
map.把要记的内容挂到熟悉空间的固定位置，练联想记忆。: Attach what you need to remember to fixed positions in a familiar space and practice associative memory.
map.背单词、记清单、备赛时用。: Use it for memorizing vocabulary, lists and competition preparation.
map.选家里 5 个位置(门/沙发/桌/窗/床)，每桩挂 2 件：门口放「牛奶+鸡蛋」: Pick 5 places at home (door / sofa / table / window / bed) and hang 2 items on each: milk and eggs at the door, apples and bread on the sofa, and so on; walk the route in order to recall, and the 10 items are hard to miss.
map.把 apple/book/cat/dog/sun 分别「放」在 5 个房间桩，闭: Place apple, book, cat, dog and sun on 5 room loci, then close your eyes and walk the space once to recite them — more reliable than rote repetition.
map.桩怎么选？: How should the loci be chosen?
map.用最熟的路径(回家动线)且顺序固定；桩要鲜明有反差，挂的意象越夸张越好记。桩数随: Use the most familiar route (the way home) with a fixed order; the loci should be vivid and contrasting, and the more exaggerated the image hung on them, the better. The number of loci grows with the content, with 10-20 loci being common.
map.初学一个桩放 1 个信息最稳，熟练后可放到 2–3 个，超过 3 个容易互相干扰: Beginners do best with 1 item per locus; with practice 2-3 works, and more than 3 tend to interfere with each other. The key is that images must be exaggerated, dynamic and emotional (the more absurd, the more memorable), while static and similar items (such as a book lying on a table) get mixed up on recall. It helps to group every 10 loci into a block and leave an empty locus between blocks so adjacent groups do not bleed together.
